evidence: Changes network classification and labeling in getnodeaddresses and getrawaddrman.
rationale: Resolves contradictory behavior across RPC endpoints where getaddrmaninfo counts linked-IPv4 addresses under IPv6, but getnodeaddresses 0 "ipv6" returns nothing and getnodeaddresses 0 "ipv4" labels them as IPv4. This improves correctness and consistency of returned RPC data without breaking RPC schemas.
